key_information_units.information: Consolidated revenue for Q1 2026 reached EUR 86.97 million, up 22.4% year-over-year from EUR 71.07 million in Q1 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 2 Main financial indicators table: Revenue Q1 2026 86,970; Change 22.4%. Text: 'consolidated increased by 22.4%... MEUR 87.0'.

key_information_units.information: Consolidated net profit for Q1 2026 was EUR 5.085 million, up 25.7% year-over-year from EUR 4.045 million in Q1 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 2 table: Net profit (loss) Q1 2026 5,085; Change 25.7%. Section 6 Income statement: Profit for the period 5,085.

key_information_units.information: EBITDA for Q1 2026 was EUR 3.003 million (margin 3.5%), down 50.2% year-over-year, excluding preliminary negative goodwill of EUR 5.5 million related to the acquisition.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 2: EBITDA 3,003; -50.2%; 'EBITDA excludes preliminary negative goodwill of MEUR 5.5 related to the acquisition'.

key_information_units.information: On 16 January 2026, the Group acquired 100% of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB, adding canned milk and milk powder production; integration planned for synergies and capacity increases.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 1 Main events: 'On 16 January 2026, Vilkyškių pieninė AB completed the transaction for the acquisition of shares of Marijampolės pieno konservai UAB. 100% of the company’s shares were acquired.' Details on operations and integration.

key_information_units.information: Commercial cheese production commenced at the new Baltic Dairy Board SIA factory in Bauska, Latvia, with planned annual output of 18 thousand tons exported to over 40 countries and creation of more than 100 jobs.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Introductory main events: 'VILVI Group has started commercial cheese production in Latvia... factory will create more than 100 jobs, and the planned cheese production volumes will reach 18 thousand tons per year. These products will be exported to more than 40 countries worldwide.'

key_information_units.information: Q1 2026 segment revenue: cheese/cheese products and other EUR 37.64 million (down 28.8%); fresh milk products EUR 12.75 million (up 73.4%); dry milk products EUR 24.66 million (up 126.9%); new canned milk segment EUR 11.92 million (14% of total).
key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 4 Sales revenue by operating segments table: Cheese 37,641 (-28.8%); Fresh 12,748 (73.4%); Dry 24,659 (126.9%); Canned 11,923; Total 86,970.

key_information_units.information: Net financial debt increased to EUR 83.43 million as of 31 March 2026, up 89.7% from EUR 43.97 million at end of Q1 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 2 table: Net financial debt Q1 2026 83,427; Change 89.7%. Balance sheet shows borrowings rise to 56,313 non-current + 25,758 current.

key_information_units.information: Milk purchased volume reached 155,954 tons in Q1 2026, up 54.2% year-over-year from 101,118 tons in Q1 2025.
key_information_units.source_evidence: Section 2 table: Purchased basic indicators milk Q1 2026 155,954; Change 54.2%. Text: 'a total of 156 thousand tons of basic indicators milk was purchased (an increase of 54.2%)'.
